models_evaluated: custom deep learning pathology framework for SGC vs SC classification

links.outcome: Pathologist diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: Pathologist accuracy improved with the AI framework, 60.0 ± 9.8% vs. 76.8 ± 9.6%.
links.quote: The accuracy of the pathologists could be improved with the AI framework (60.0 ± 9.8% vs. 76.8 ± 9.6%).

links.outcome: Model accuracy in internal versus external hospital testing sets
links.effect: SGC accuracy 84.85% internal vs 22.22% external; SC accuracy 75.12% internal vs 77.78% external.
links.quote: In WSI level, the diagnostic accuracy of SGC and SC achieved 84.85% and 75.12%, respectively, in the internal testing set and reached 22.22% and 77.78%, respectively, in the external testing set.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of pathologists with versus without AI assistance in an offline reader study.
